# The Cowork

> Coworking space beside Johar Town, Lahore, Pakistan (formerly ShareSpace). Every seat is PKR 15,000 a month: hot desks, a 6-person private office (PKR 90,000/month) and a 15-person private office (PKR 225,000/month). Members have 24/7 access, with a 6 PM–3 AM night shift for US and UK client hours.

Founded in 2023 by Khawaja Farukh Ishfaq and Umar Khan.

## Key facts

- Address: 95 College Road, PCSIR Staff Colony, Lahore 54770, Pakistan
- Phone: +92 333 4835258, +92 300 4449874
- WhatsApp: +92 308 7770222
- Email: thecoworkpk@gmail.com
- Access: open 24 hours, 7 days a week for members
- Reception: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM daily
- Night shift: 6:00 PM – 3:00 AM, with security on site all night
- Included in every plan: fibre internet with a backup line, generator plus UPS power backup, tea and filtered water, cleaning, on-site parking, biometric entry and CCTV
- Meeting rooms: sound-insulated, with whiteboards; screens and conference audio are being installed
- Rates last updated: October 2026

## Plans

- [Pricing](https://thecowork.pk/pricing): the full published rate card
- [Hot Desk](https://thecowork.pk/hot-desk-lahore): any free desk in the open workspace, PKR 15,000 a month
- [6-Person Office](https://thecowork.pk/team-office-lahore): private furnished office for six, PKR 15,000 per seat (PKR 90,000 a month)
- [15-Person Office](https://thecowork.pk/private-office-lahore): private furnished office for fifteen, PKR 15,000 per seat (PKR 225,000 a month)
- [Meeting Rooms](https://thecowork.pk/meeting-rooms-lahore): included with membership, bookable by the hour
